class.name: ARPlaneTracker
class.brief_description: Live detected-plane geometry registered with XRServer.
class.description: Trackers are named pocketar/plane/<generation>/<id> and updated in place. Use [member ARFramePacket.planes] for copied geometry from a particular frame. The inherited default pose is valid while tracking. World units are metres. Plane-local coordinates are XZ with +Y normal; transforms are world-from-plane and extents are full lengths. Identity is scoped to a session generation. Subsumed planes remain aliases but default visualization and raycasts omit them. A plane tracker is not a game-created anchor, even though its XR tracker type is TRACKER_ANCHOR.

members.member: An [enum Alignment] ordinal, not a [enum PocketAR.AlignmentMask] bit. Use 1 shifted by this value to form a mask bit.
Full plane lengths along local X and Z in metres. Raycasts use the polygon, not this bounding rectangle.
Copied polygon vertices as local XZ pairs in metres, with +Y normal.
Session identity that owns this plane. Reset removes old trackers and invalidates old plane identities.
Replacement plane ID in this generation, or zero if not subsumed.
Current [enum TrackingState]. Paused/stopped and subsumed planes do not produce placement hits.
World-from-plane transform in metres; basis +Y is the plane normal.

constants.constant: The plane has a tracked pose and can be used for placement.
